data.name: Descr_Dawnstar
data.value: A mysterious blade. When touching it you can hear a faint voice in your head: "Motherfucker?"

data.name: Descr_DwarvenWarHammer
data.value: A heavy war hammer of finest dwarfen craftsmanship. Go smash some heads!

data.name: Descr_BladeofCreation
data.value: This cursed sword is said to kill everyone it slices instantly. The creators of this world themselves supposedly wielded this blade! And the best thing is: I'll give it to you for free. Try not to cut your finger though, or you might die.

data.name: Descr_IronBat
data.value: An iron baseball bat. Here's a free hint: If you look closely, you can see that your enemies' heads are basically floating balls. Why not try for a homerun?

data.name: Descr_Mace
data.value: Heavy and spiky. I wouldn't want to get hit by that.

data.name: Descr_Morningstar
data.value: My personal favorite! This cursed blade can only be wielded by high ranking demons such as myself. Why am I selling it to you? Because I'm certain you could not afford it anyways.

data.name: Descr_OnyxBlade
data.value: A truly remarkable sword. It cuts through bone like through warm butter. It can never be sheathed though, as there is no material that can hold this sword without being sliced.

data.name: Descr_SteelStraightSword
data.value: A normal steel sword. A suitable weapon for a weakling like you.

data.name: Descr_SteelWarHammer
data.value: A heavy war hammer. Requires quite some strength to be wielded effectively.

data.name: Descr_WoodenBat
data.value: A wooden baseball bat. Tool of choice for some rowdy delinquents. It could use some nails though.

data.name: Descr_WoodenStraightSword
data.value: A child's toy. Not suitable for combat. It still hurts quite a bit when hitting it in your face though. If you require proof, I'm always happy to break some noses!
